title: LumiGrid Preset Link Schema
description: Schema for linking presets across nodes - one node's preset can trigger/affect another node's preset

id.description: Unique identifier for the preset link

description.description: Optional description of the link behavior

source_preset.description: Name of the source preset that triggers the link

target_node.description: Target node identifier (IP, hostname, or node ID)

target_preset.description: Name of the preset to trigger on the target node

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering target preset

enabled.description: Whether the link is currently active
